svg.title: Computed stiffness against mesh node count. Linear tetrahedra fall steadily from 11,890 to 11,364 N/mm without settling. Quadratic elements on the same meshes stay inside a narrow band between 10,103 and 10,185 N/mm from the coarsest mesh onward.
